sentences.text:
1. The instant bail application under Sections 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 read with Sections 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed by the petitioner/applicant seeking the following relief:-
"Grant Regular Bail to the Applicant/ Accused namely Deepak in FIR No. 398/2022,
dated 20.04.2022 U/s.365/366/366A/368/323/506/509/370/372/376 (2) (n)/34 IPC Sec 6 POCSO & Sec 4, 5, 6 of IT (P) Act.

P.S. Khyala, West Delhi."
2. Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/12/2024 at 06:11:13 perused the contents made in the petition.
Notice is accepted by learned APP appearing on advance notice on behalf of the respondent/State.
He prayed for four weeks' time to file a Status Report.
Let the same be filed within four weeks as prayed.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J DECEMBER 12, 2024 NA/mk
